elements.requirement: Section 189B applies where the local housing authority are satisfied that an applicant is both homeless and eligible for assistance.
elements.quote: This section applies where the local housing authority are satisfied that an applicant is— (a) homeless, and (b) eligible for assistance.

elements.requirement: Unless the local housing authority refer the application to another local housing authority in England under section 198(A1), the authority must take reasonable steps to help the applicant secure that suitable accommodation becomes available for the applicant's occupation for at least 6 months or such longer prescribed period not exceeding 12 months.
elements.quote: Unless the authority refer the application to another local housing authority in England (see section 198(A1)), the authority must take reasonable steps to help the applicant to secure that suitable accommodation becomes available for the applicant's occupation

elements.requirement: In deciding what steps to take, the local housing authority must have regard to their assessment of the applicant's case carried out under section 189A.
elements.quote: In deciding what steps they are to take, the authority must have regard to their assessment of the applicant's case under section 189A.

elements.requirement: Where the local housing authority are satisfied that the applicant has a priority need and are not satisfied that the applicant became homeless intentionally, the duty under subsection (2) ends automatically at the end of 56 days beginning with the day the authority are first satisfied that the applicant is homeless and eligible for assistance.
elements.quote: Where the authority— (a) are satisfied that the applicant has a priority need, and (b) are not satisfied that the applicant became homeless intentionally, the duty under subsection (2) comes to an end at the end of the period of 56 days beginning with the day the authority are first satisfied as mentioned in subsection (1).

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may give notice to the applicant bringing the duty under subsection (2) to an end if any of the circumstances specified in subsection (7) apply.
elements.quote: If any of the circumstances mentioned in subsection (7) apply, the authority may give notice to the applicant bringing the duty under subsection (2) to an end.

elements.requirement: A notice bringing the duty to an end under subsection (5) must specify which circumstance applies, inform the applicant of their right to request a review of the decision, and state the time within which such a review request must be made.
elements.quote: The notice must— (a) specify which of the circumstances apply, and (b) inform the applicant that the applicant has a right to request a review of the authority's decision to bring the duty under subsection (2) to an end and of the time within which such a request must be made.

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may end the duty by notice if satisfied that the applicant has suitable accommodation available for occupation and a reasonable prospect of having suitable accommodation available for occupation for at least 6 months (or a prescribed period not exceeding 12 months) from the date of the notice.
elements.quote: the applicant has— (i) suitable accommodation available for occupation, and (ii) a reasonable prospect of having suitable accommodation available for occupation for at least 6 months, or such longer period not exceeding 12 months as may be prescribed, from the date of the notice

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may end the duty by notice if satisfied that they have complied with the duty under subsection (2) and 56 days beginning with the day they were first satisfied of homelessness and eligibility have ended, regardless of whether the applicant secured accommodation.
elements.quote: the authority have complied with the duty under subsection (2) and the period of 56 days beginning with the day that the authority are first satisfied as mentioned in subsection (1) has ended (whether or not the applicant has secured accommodation)

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may end the duty by notice if satisfied that the applicant has refused an offer of suitable accommodation where, on the date of refusal, there was a reasonable prospect that suitable accommodation would be available for occupation by the applicant for at least 6 months or a prescribed period not exceeding 12 months.
elements.quote: the applicant has refused an offer of suitable accommodation and, on the date of refusal, there was a reasonable prospect that suitable accommodation would be available for occupation by the applicant for at least 6 months or such longer period not exceeding 12 months as may be prescribed

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may end the duty by notice if satisfied that the applicant has become homeless intentionally from accommodation made available to the applicant through the authority's exercise of functions under subsection (2).
elements.quote: the applicant has become homeless intentionally from any accommodation that has been made available to the applicant as a result of the authority's exercise of their functions under subsection (2)

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may end the duty by notice if satisfied that the applicant is no longer eligible for assistance.
elements.quote: the applicant is no longer eligible for assistance

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may end the duty by notice if satisfied that the applicant has withdrawn the application mentioned in section 183(1).
elements.quote: the applicant has withdrawn the application mentioned in section 183(1).

elements.requirement: A notice under section 189B must be given in writing.
elements.quote: A notice under this section must be given in writing

elements.requirement: If a notice under section 189B is not received by the applicant, it is treated as having been given to the applicant if made available at the local housing authority's office for a reasonable period for collection by or on behalf of the applicant.
elements.quote: if not received by the applicant, is to be treated as having been given to the applicant if it is made available at the authority's office for a reasonable period for collection by or on behalf of the applicant.

elements.requirement: The duty under subsection (2) may also be brought to an end under section 193A as a consequence of the refusal of a final accommodation offer or a final Part 6 offer at the initial relief stage.
elements.quote: The duty under subsection (2) can also be brought to an end under— (a) section 193A (consequences of refusal of final accommodation offer or final Part 6 offer at the initial relief stage)

elements.requirement: The duty under subsection (2) may also be brought to an end under sections 193B and 193C by notices given where the applicant deliberately and unreasonably refuses to co-operate.
elements.quote: sections 193B and 193C (notices in cases of applicant's deliberate and unreasonable refusal to co-operate).

Maximum period that may be prescribed for which suitable accommodation must become available under the section 189B(2) duty
thresholds.quote: such longer period not exceeding 12 months as may be prescribed.

thresholds.what: Period after which the duty under subsection (2) automatically ends for an applicant with priority need who did not become homeless intentionally
thresholds.quote: period of 56 days beginning with the day the authority are first satisfied as mentioned in subsection (1).

thresholds.what: Minimum prospective period from the date of notice for which an applicant must have a reasonable prospect of suitable accommodation available to allow notice ending the duty under subsection (7)(a)
thresholds.quote: for at least 6 months, or such longer period not exceeding 12 months as may be prescribed, from the date of the notice

thresholds.what: Maximum prescribed prospective period from the date of notice for which an applicant must have a reasonable prospect of suitable accommodation available to allow notice ending the duty under subsection (7)(a)
thresholds.quote: such longer period not exceeding 12 months as may be prescribed, from the date of the notice

thresholds.what: Period that must have elapsed since the authority was first satisfied of homelessness and eligibility before the authority can end the duty by notice on compliance grounds under subsection (7)(b)
thresholds.quote: the period of 56 days beginning with the day that the authority are first satisfied as mentioned in subsection (1) has ended

thresholds.what: Minimum prospective period of suitable accommodation availability required on the date of refusal to end the duty under subsection (7)(c)
thresholds.quote: for at least 6 months or such longer period not exceeding 12 months as may be prescribed
